inputs.text: Minimal flat vector app logo mark: a geometric capital letter A built from two thick rounded strokes meeting at a sharp apex, with a play-button triangle as negative space in the lower center of the A. Smooth indigo to pink gradient fill from left to right. Perfectly centered on a plain white background with generous margin. Crisp clean edges, professional logo design, no text, no words, no photo, no shadows
